kehillah_reform.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = kehillah_reform.0002.t
	desc = kehillah_reform.0002.desc
	theme = faith
	left_portrait = { character = root animation = thinking }
	trigger = { exists = involved_activity exists = var:kehillah_reform_tenet }
	option = {
		name = kehillah_reform.0002.core
		trigger = { kehillah_reform_chosen_can_core_trigger = yes }
		custom_tooltip = kehillah_reform.0002.core.tt
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_action value = flag:core }
		trigger_event = kehillah_reform.0003
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { add = 100 rite ?= { var:kehillah_reform_pending_action ?= flag:core } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = kehillah_reform.0002.permit
		trigger = { kehillah_reform_chosen_can_permit_trigger = yes }
		custom_tooltip = kehillah_reform.0002.permit.tt
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_action value = flag:permit }
		kehillah_reform_put_motion_effect = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}
	option = {
		name = kehillah_reform.0002.ban
		trigger = { kehillah_reform_chosen_can_ban_trigger = yes }
		custom_tooltip = kehillah_reform.0002.ban.tt
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_action value = flag:ban }
		kehillah_reform_put_motion_effect = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 5
			modifier = { add = 100 rite ?= { var:kehillah_reform_pending_action ?= flag:ban } }
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = zealous }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = kehillah_reform.0002.lift
		trigger = { kehillah_reform_chosen_can_lift_trigger = yes }
		custom_tooltip = kehillah_reform.0002.lift.tt
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_action value = flag:lift }
		kehillah_reform_put_motion_effect = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}
	option = {
		name = kehillah_reform.0002.back
		kehillah_reform_clear_choice_effect = yes
		trigger_event = kehillah_reform.0001
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
	}
}
